name: wertkurs
description: The brand system of wertkurs (Matthias Schwarz, full-service financial advisor). A deliberately human, un-bank-like fintech look: clean neo-grotesque type in UPPERCASE, a signature mint-green field, a Ming→Lotus wordmark gradient, an 80s cassette-sleeve spectrum pinstripe, and 16-bit pixel-art brand characters (Werner the flamingo, founder emoticons). Clear structure, edutainment voice, German Du-form.

source.origin: wertkurs Design System (brand of Matthias Schwarz / Vertriebspartner FiNUM.Finanzhaus AG). Re-authored into the Open Design package contract from the bundled wertkurs colors_and_type.css foundation.
